tool.name: Add input name as column

param.name: input
param.label: Input file
param.help: Input file to add the name to

param.name: name
param.label: Name of the column
param.help: Name of the column to add

tool.help:
**What it does**
Adds a new column with the name of the input file as it appears in the history. By default the column is appended.
-----
.. class:: infomark
**TIP:** If your data is not TAB delimited, use *Text Manipulation->Convert*
